title: Zorro's Forge
subtitle: Procedural 3D asset generator
description:
Zorro's Forge is a browser-based procedural 3D generator for creators who need a fast library of stylized assets without modeling every prop, creature, or environment piece by hand.

Pick a category, tweak the style, material, and colors, then forge the asset and download it as an OBJ + MTL pack with texture maps, ready for Blender, Unity, or Unreal. Over 5,000 generatable objects, from armor and vehicles to creatures and everyday props.

It is live now: free with ads, or ad-free with a subscription.
